newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Rabobank starts Danubius coverage with buy.
newsitem.headline: Rabobank starts Danubius coverage with buy.

text.p: Rabobank Investments Ltd started coverage of Hungarian hotel chain Danubius Rt with a 'buy' recommendation, saying they saw more growth potential for the company and its share price.
"Based on the market value of its assets and the valuation of its earnings with respect to comparable companies, we recommend buying shares in Danubius," analyst Anthony Vago said in a report.
"The company is expected to make further acquisitions of domestic hotels," he added.

Danubius acquired a majority stake in hotel chain Hungaria Szalloda in 1996, and Vago said he expected Danubius to maintain its majority stake in Hungaria after it is floated on the stock exchange later this year or early next year.
Vago expected Danubius to posted an earnings per share of 199.4 forints in 1997 and 336.2 forints in 1998.
Rabobank Investment Ltd is the securities arm of Rabobank Hungaria, which is a unit of Rabobank Nederland.
